title: Slovakian Pork Wrap
description: A delicious Slovakian-inspired pork wrap with a hint of smokiness from grilling. Serve with a side of coleslaw or pickled vegetables for added crunch.
instructions: Season pork tenderloin with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Grill pork tenderloin for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let pork tenderloin rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Meanwhile, grill onion for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it's lightly charred.
Warm the Slovakian-style wrap in the oven or by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading mayonnaise on the bottom half, then adding sliced pork tenderloin, grilled onion, and chopped parsley.
Top with the remaining half of the wrap and serve immediately.
